specifications.housing: Sheet metal cabinet powder coated dark black inside to eliminate reflections
specifications.tubes: Available in 2-tube or 3-tube configurations (254 nm short wave and 365 nm long wave)
specifications.eyepiece: Protective optical filter viewing visor ensuring user safety from UV radiation

applications: TLC plate spot visualization in pharmaceutical analysis
Forensic document and counterfeit currency inspection
Mineralogy, petrology, and biochemical fluorometry

products.name: Lyophiliser (Freeze Drier)
products.tagline: Cell Structure Preservation with Vacuum Drum & Cold Trap
products.description: Used for preservation of blood plasma, plant extracts, bacteria, and vaccines without damaging cellular structure. Equipped with a stainless steel cooling condenser trap, clear acrylic vacuum drum with manifold ports, and high-vacuum rotary vane pump in a steel cabinet.

specifications.capacities: 3 Liters or 5 Liters condensate ice capacity
specifications.cabinet: Enclosed steel cabinet housing refrigeration compressor and vacuum pump

applications: Preservation of bacterial and fungal culture stocks
Pharmaceutical peptide and enzyme lyophilization
Heat-labile botanical extract drying

products.name: Magnetic Stirrer
products.tagline: Smooth Stepless Speed Regulation - With or Without Hot Plate
products.description: Benchtop laboratory magnetic stirrer supplied with stepless speed regulator. Available with or without top heating plate for simultaneous heating and stirring of chemical reagents and solutions.
applications: Reagent dissolution and titration stirring
General chemistry and biochemistry sample preparation

products.name: Melting Point Apparatus
products.tagline: Accurate Melting Point Determination up to 350°C
products.description: For determination of melting points of chemical substances up to 350°C. The aluminum heating block accepts three capillary tubes and a mercury thermometer, illuminated from below by a lamp fixed in the housing to provide uniform, shadow-free viewing.
applications: Identification and purity checking of organic chemical syntheses
Pharmaceutical active ingredient verification

products.name: Mortuary Chamber
products.tagline: Cadaver Storage Refrigerator (2°C to 50°C) with Movable Trays
products.description: Double-walled morgue refrigerator designed for hygienic cold preservation of cadavers. Features corrosion-free metal components, advanced polyurethane insulation, heavy door locking system, hermetic refrigeration compressor, and movable stainless steel body trays on telescopic ball-bearing rollers.

specifications.trays: Heavy gauge stainless steel sliding body trays on smooth ball-bearing tracks
specifications.insulation: High-density PUF insulation for maximum thermal efficiency

applications: Hospital and forensic mortuaries
Medical college anatomy departments

products.name: Round Hot Plate
products.tagline: Circular Cast Iron Heating Plate on Heavy Tripod Base
products.description: Classic circular laboratory hot plate featuring a heavy machined cast iron surface mounted on a sturdy tripod base. Fitted with a 3-heat rotary selector switch for low, medium, and high temperature heating.

specifications.plate: 20 cm (8 inch) diameter heavy cast iron plate

applications: General chemistry lab heating and boiling
Sample evaporation and preparation

products.name: Electric Bunsen Burner
products.tagline: Flameless Electric Radiative Heat for Inoculation Loops & Test Tubes
products.description: Flameless electric alternative to traditional gas Bunsen burners. Ideal for use inside laminar air flow clean benches where open gas flames create air turbulence and fire hazards. Utilizes a ceramic heating chimney to provide intense radiative heat.

specifications.chimney: Ceramic heating crucible reaching up to 800°C for rapid loop glowing

applications: Inoculation loop and needle sterilisation inside laminar hoods
Microbiological test tube mouth flaming without gas cylinder hazards

products.name: Slide Warming Table
products.tagline: Uniform Flat Heated Surface for Histology & Cytology Slides
products.description: Low-profile laboratory slide warming table for flattening paraffin-embedded tissue ribbon sections and drying microscope slides in histology, pathology, and cytology laboratories. Features an anodized black top plate with uniform heating up to 70°C.

specifications.surface: Anodized black aluminum surface for high contrast against transparent slides
specifications.tempRange: Ambient to 70°C controlled by hydraulic thermostat or digital controller
specifications.capacity: Holds 40 to 60 standard 75 x 25 mm microscope slides

applications: Paraffin tissue section stretching and drying in microtomy
Cytology smear and blood smear fixation
